Lauren breathes "So it bleeds." the man in his 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tariq mutters "So it bleeds." the man in his 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" 🔥 The fire settles. Sanjay has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Choir Toad — I put it down today." "Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once." "It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikau says "And you're still standing." Marcus mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Lauren has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tomas says "So it bleeds." Tariq says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Declan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Owen breathes "Say that again — slower." Lauren says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nikau has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hassan mutters "So it bleeds." Tariq says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Tariq has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marcus says "The fire feels smaller now." Mara asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
